status: Prospective, not implemented or executed; only qualified source/layout/proof results exist

inputs.name: original
inputs.transform: Original corpus, appending the monotonically increasing 8-byte BE mutation ordinal for unique insertion

inputs.name: wide128
inputs.transform: Pad each original 27-byte key to 128 bytes with zeroes; then append the same ordinal for unique insertion. Fixed-length padding preserves original key order and equality.

before_timing: Build fresh ordinary ThinLTO release baseline/candidate with original registry dependencies; identify exact source and ELF hashes and invalidate first-party artifacts.
Qualify actual engine release paths with independent decoded/rekeyed models, every prefix, old snapshots, applied position/revision and CF sentinels.
Use a separate allocation-only companion with exact operation/output lifetime correspondence. No elapsed time from counted builds.

Retain the 198 selected allocation observations across empty/nonempty, short/long keys and values. Actual EntryBuffer is 24 bytes; entry requests save 24 bytes and one buffer allocation iff both key and value are nonempty. Qualify full-map/pinned lifetimes independently.

stage_one.case_product: 2 datasets x overwrite/unique insertion x no old view/retained old view
stage_one.scope: ReplicatedEngine::write_applied per retained group; batch construction and old-view acquisition/drop outside; consumed input destruction and position/revision updates inside; the new whole-batch length preflight remains inside write_applied timing
stage_one.gate: All four original-dataset write means improve at least 10% pooled, improve in both orders, and p99 increases no more than 2%. Wide128 write mean/p99 increase no more than 2%. Exact data/position/refusal checks must pass. If any write gate fails, hold the candidate and stop before the remaining timing panels; never relabel skipped panels as passed.

stage_two.scope: Reuse original engine-interface snapshot/owned/resident, first-probe/warm, per-call/512-query-pass read panels for both datasets and both map sizes. Add scan, iter, iter_rev, seek_le, checksum and delete_range windows for both datasets and map sizes.
stage_two.case_count_derivation: 2 datasets x 18 existing non-write cases + 2 datasets x 2 map sizes x 6 range/delete operations
stage_two.ranges: Deterministic 512 probe anchors without replacement, 16-entry half-open ranges; scan/iter/reverse return and retain 16 owned rows until after the measured window. Reverse seek returns at most one row. Consume streaming iterators inside the window; validate/drop outputs outside. Timed delete_range starts from a fresh independently verified state, preserves an old view and checks exact remaining rows; no state reset inside timing.
stage_two.snapshot_scope: Separate acquisition/drop and bounded snapshot allocation observations. One fixed captured view per read epoch; verify old view after an untimed mutation.
stage_two.gate: Every read/snapshot/range/delete pooled mean and p99 increases no more than 2%; retain both orders and each timer scope. Whole-pass p99 is never request p99.

allocation_acceptance: Independently account six request fields, requested live/peak bytes and every window. For nonempty key/value puts, predict one fewer buffer allocation and 24 fewer requested bytes per newly constructed entry. Retained old entries/CF sentinels and intermediate persistent paths must be modeled explicitly; final live-index reduction should be 24 bytes per live entry in each dataset, including sentinels. Empty key/value behavior is separately qualified. No time from counted builds; counts do not prove jemalloc size-class/RSS behavior.
limits: Shared-host component screen, not database QPS. No parameter/alignment sweep or retry of a completed matrix. Production remains unchanged until material matched database benefit, full local correctness, ordinary recovery, actual Chaos Mesh and three-copy Redis throughput/latency pass. Industrial durability, bounded multi-Raft and automatic range splits remain open.
